description: Plan v7 section 8.3: the Indic `i = 0 or n = 1` cardinal family (hi, bn, gu) carried through the translation path at 10^17, 10^18, and 10^20 as well as through both the i = 0 and the n = 1 branches. Each locale's generated placeholder tags the category it selected so the recorded translation names the branch. Every non-fallback catalog is selected by at least one case. No two loaded locales share a primary language code, so tiebreakers are absent.

{{itemCount}} counted.commentary: The required fallback catalog. Emits only the generated form so that if fallback ever were used the recorded translation would name it.
